title: SCHC version option is omitted from non-root DIOs and breaks multi-hop admission
description: Rule 7 and versioning correctness rereview: spec says only DODAG roots advertise the SCHC version option while also requiring every joining node to reject a DIO without it. Python and Rust serializers auto-insert 13 01 03 only at rank 256; Rust non-root Dio has no option writer at all. Beyond one hop, candidates receive non-root parent DIOs without the mandatory option and cannot join. Define propagation semantics and require every DIO used for parent or DODAG admission to carry exactly one canonical version option, or explicitly bind admission to authenticated root state distributed another way. Add root, non-root, two-hop, duplicate, missing, and mismatch vectors in Python and Rust.
